Next RAN1 meeting (RAN1#121) is the last meeting for the WID. Support from all interested companies is needed in order to finish the work on time. Please identify all remaining issues and ways to close them at next meeting. In RAN1#120bis, several issues were heavily debated but are not resolved in the end. Please bring your suggestion on how to move forward in next meeting. Two are highlighted below: LOS/NLOS indicator and related timing information (see section 3.1). Specifically, proposal 3.1.4-1 and 3.1.5-1 were still left open. Assistance info to ensure consistency training and inference for Case 1.

The following agenda has been finished in RAN1 #114 for measurements and reporting for SL positionning. Some remaining issues can be further disussed in RAN1 #115. In this summary, we summarize some common elements in the contributions and identify some areas and positions where contributing companies are aligned from which some agreements could be derived. The proposals are ranked according to HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW. The intention is to start in the offline/online sessions from the HIGH proposals. The following papers have been submitted to the RAN1 #114bis.
